gbm_population_evidence.quote: I03. Newly diagnosed GBM, presumed on the basis of clinical and MRI criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: 5-ALA HCl, 20 mg/kg, is orally administered 4-6 hours before the surgery. Then after resection of tumor tissue is judged maximal, the intraoperative PDT procedure is initiated at 200 J/cm\^2.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: male and female patients aged 18 to 75 with newly diagnosed glioblastoma

agents.agent_name_registered: 5-ALA HCl intraoperative Photodynamic Therapy (PDT) (Pentalafen, 5-aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride)

role_evidence.quote: two doses of light in intraoperative PDT added to standard of care; temozolomide-based chemotherapy

agents.drug_class_hint: photosensitiser prodrug (protoporphyrin IX precursor) for photodynamic therapy

role_evidence.quote: I07. Planned to receive SOC (i.e., Stupp Protocol) treatment after surgery.

coder_notes: 5-ALA given orally then activated by intraoperative illumination to kill tumour (PDT, light dose escalation), so candidate with device_dependent true (C12), not a diagnostic agent. Temozolomide/Stupp is not a registered intervention but the summary and I07 say every patient receives it, listed as soc_backbone; radiotherapy is not listed as an agent.
